svg.title: Craft backend meta-types: semantic contracts and relationships
svg.desc: Thirteen backend types in four categories, connected by seventeen canonical relationship signatures. Highlighting follows six explanatory phases. Animation indicates relationships, not a prescribed runtime execution order.
svg.text: 13 active types • 4 categories • 17 canonical relationship signatures
Taxonomy names each kind of concept. Ontology connects the concepts with directed meaning.
Equality is determined by its fields.
Closed, finite set of named variants.
Changes state; declares reads, writes and effects.
Guard before mutation; explicit failure continuation.
Reads entity data with typed inputs and results.
No state mutation or side effects.
Pure value derived from declared inputs.
Formula, rounding and error behavior are explicit.
Typed Boolean condition: allow or block.
Gates whether an Operation may execute.
Explicit conditions, default and ambiguity handling.
Coordinates ordered Operations in declared scope.
Typed record of a fact that already happened.
Projects source fields into a target shape.
Direction, conversions and totality are explicit.
States, initial state and valid transitions.
They do not prescribe an execution schedule.
Enum supplies typed field/state references; it has no dedicated backend edge.
Mapping projects shape; it does not construct, persist or invoke.
Saga is represented by Workflow; it is not a separate active type.

g.text: Identity, values, behavior, boundaries and lifecycle.
Rules gate; Calculations derive; Workflows coordinate.
Interfaces expose; Policies choose; Mappings project.
Reads, creation, embedded values and event subjects.
Events activate behavior; Operations project to other features.
Lifecycle responsibility and assignment carry different meaning.
